questions.question: Whom does Malachi 2 especially rebuke for corrupting the covenant?
options: The kings, who had led all of the people into a great and costly war
The priests, who had turned aside and caused many to stumble
The merchants, who had cheated everyone with their false scales
The prophets, who had spoken only their own dreams to the people
questions.answer: The priests, who had turned aside and caused many to stumble

questions.question: What does Malachi 2 say God hates regarding marriage?
options: Breaking and profaning the holy rest of the Sabbath day
Idolatry committed openly on the high places of the hills
Divorce (faithlessness against the wife of one's youth)
Robbery of the silver and gold of the temple treasury
questions.answer: Divorce (faithlessness against the wife of one's youth)

questions.question: Malachi 2 says the lips of a priest should guard knowledge, and people should seek instruction from him.
'For I hate _____,' says the LORD, the God of Israel.
Do we not all have one Father? Did not one God _____ us?
